hook: What links Pablo Escobar to Winnie the Pooh?
title: Pablo Escobar to Winnie the Pooh: how?
description: A TV star, two presidents, a first lady and NBC's Willard Scott connect Pablo Escobar to Winnie the Pooh in six real photos.

links.line: In 1983, Colombian TV star Virginia Vallejo interviewed Pablo Escobar.
In 1984, Vallejo was photographed with Colombia's president, Belisario Betancur.
In 1985, Betancur visited Ronald Reagan at the White House.

image.file: File:President Ronald Reagan and Nancy Reagan with Frank Sinatra (cropped).jpg

links.line: In 1981, Reagan and his wife, Nancy, laughed together in the Oval Office.

image.file: File:Nancy Reagan Attending The Great American Family Awards Presentation with Willard Scott in The State Dining Room - DPLA - 201e390316bae8d32c9e78c13ae7aff0.jpg

links.line: In 1986, NBC weatherman Willard Scott gave Nancy a bear hug.

image.file: File:Group Shot of Cartoon-Comic Book Characters with Willard Scott During The Easter Egg Roll on The South Lawn - DPLA - a4a78b89f6ad3de82e82823717f31fb2.jpg

links.line: And in 1983, at the Easter Egg Roll, Scott met Winnie the Pooh.
